name: Honua.Postgres.Migrations.008_AddRasterSamplingFunctions.sql
commands:
-- Additive sampler functions. Each body is bound from the same C# definition the server ships.
-- SET search_path stops the planner from inlining an unused fallback into the tile query.
-- That is a planning boundary, not a JIT-policy change. No raster table or tile payload changes.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS honua_raster
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA honua_raster TO PUBLIC

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION honua_raster.native_window_v1(p_raster raster, p_grid raster)
RETURNS raster
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY INVOKER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
AS $$
SELECT (
    WITH window_input AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT p_raster AS rast, p_grid AS grid
    ), window_eligible AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT i.*, ST_MakeEmptyRaster(i.rast) AS header
        FROM window_input i
        WHERE i.rast IS NOT NULL AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(i.rast)
          AND ST_SkewX(i.rast) = 0 AND ST_SkewY(i.rast) = 0
          AND ST_SkewX(i.grid) = 0 AND ST_SkewY(i.grid) = 0
          AND ST_ScaleX(i.rast) > 0 AND ST_ScaleY(i.rast) < 0
          AND ST_ScaleX(i.grid) > 0 AND ST_ScaleY(i.grid) < 0
          AND abs(ST_ScaleX(i.rast)) BETWEEN 1e-100 AND 1e100
          AND abs(ST_ScaleY(i.rast)) BETWEEN 1e-100 AND 1e100
          AND abs(ST_UpperLeftX(i.rast)) < 1e100
          AND abs(ST_UpperLeftY(i.rast)) < 1e100
          AND abs(ST_ScaleX(i.grid)) BETWEEN 1e-100 AND 1e100
          AND abs(ST_ScaleY(i.grid)) BETWEEN 1e-100 AND 1e100
          AND abs(ST_UpperLeftX(i.grid)) < 1e100
          AND abs(ST_UpperLeftY(i.grid)) < 1e100
          AND ST_NumBands(i.rast) > 0
          AND ((ST_SRID(i.rast) = ST_SRID(i.grid) AND ST_SRID(i.rast) > 0)
               OR (ST_SRID(i.rast) = 4326 AND ST_SRID(i.grid) = 3857
                   AND ST_XMin(ST_Envelope(i.grid)) >= -20037508.342789244
                   AND ST_XMax(ST_Envelope(i.grid)) <= 20037508.342789244
                   AND ST_YMin(ST_Envelope(i.grid)) >= -20037508.342789244
                   AND ST_YMax(ST_Envelope(i.grid)) <= 20037508.342789244))
    ), window_inverse AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT i.*, CASE WHEN ST_SRID(i.rast) = ST_SRID(i.grid)
                         THEN ST_Envelope(i.grid)
                         ELSE ST_Transform(ST_Envelope(i.grid), 4326) END AS bounds
        FROM window_eligible i
    ), window_coordinate_guard AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT i.* FROM window_inverse i
        WHERE (ST_XMin(bounds)::numeric - ST_UpperLeftX(header)::numeric)
                    / NULLIF(ST_ScaleX(header)::numeric, 0) BETWEEN -2147483644 AND 2147483644
          AND (ST_XMax(bounds)::numeric - ST_UpperLeftX(header)::numeric)
                    / NULLIF(ST_ScaleX(header)::numeric, 0) BETWEEN -2147483644 AND 2147483644
          AND (ST_YMin(bounds)::numeric - ST_UpperLeftY(header)::numeric)
                    / NULLIF(ST_ScaleY(header)::numeric, 0) BETWEEN -2147483644 AND 2147483644
          AND (ST_YMax(bounds)::numeric - ST_UpperLeftY(header)::numeric)
                    / NULLIF(ST_ScaleY(header)::numeric, 0) BETWEEN -2147483644 AND 2147483644
    ), window_cells AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT i.*, least(c1.columnx, c2.columnx) - 1 AS c0,
               greatest(c1.columnx, c2.columnx) + 1 AS c1,
               least(c1.rowy, c2.rowy) - 1 AS r0,
               greatest(c1.rowy, c2.rowy) + 1 AS r1
        FROM window_coordinate_guard i
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_WorldToRasterCoord(header, ST_XMin(bounds), ST_YMax(bounds)) c1
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_WorldToRasterCoord(header, ST_XMax(bounds), ST_YMin(bounds)) c2
    ), window_grid AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT i.*, ST_MakeEmptyRaster((c1::bigint - c0 + 1)::integer, (r1::bigint - r0 + 1)::integer, p.longitude, p.latitude,
                   ST_ScaleX(header), ST_ScaleY(header), 0, 0, ST_SRID(header)) AS native_grid
        FROM window_cells i
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_RasterToWorldCoord(header, c0, r0) p
        WHERE c1::bigint - c0 + 1 BETWEEN 1 AND 65535
          AND r1::bigint - r0 + 1 BETWEEN 1 AND 65535
          AND (c1::numeric - c0 + 1) * (r1::numeric - r0 + 1) * ST_NumBands(rast) <= 1048576
    ), window_domain AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT i.* FROM window_grid i
        WHERE ST_SRID(rast) = ST_SRID(grid)
           OR (ST_XMin(ST_Envelope(native_grid)) >= -180
               AND ST_XMax(ST_Envelope(native_grid)) <= 180
               AND ST_YMin(ST_Envelope(native_grid)) > -85.0511287798066
               AND ST_YMax(ST_Envelope(native_grid)) < 85.0511287798066)
    ), window_projected AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT i.*, CASE WHEN ST_SRID(rast) = ST_SRID(grid) THEN ST_Envelope(native_grid)
                         ELSE ST_Transform(ST_Envelope(native_grid), ST_SRID(grid)) END AS projected
        FROM window_domain i
    ), window_estimates AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT i.*,
               ceil((ST_XMax(projected)::numeric - ST_XMin(projected)::numeric)
                        / NULLIF(ST_ScaleX(grid)::numeric, 0) + 2) AS projected_width,
               ceil((ST_YMax(projected)::numeric - ST_YMin(projected)::numeric)
                        / NULLIF(abs(ST_ScaleY(grid))::numeric, 0) + 2) AS projected_height
        FROM window_projected i
    ), window_admitted AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT i.* FROM window_estimates i
        WHERE projected_width BETWEEN 1 AND 65535
          AND projected_height BETWEEN 1 AND 65535
          AND projected_width * projected_height * ST_NumBands(rast) <= 16777216
    ), window_clipped AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT i.*, ST_Clip(rast, ST_Envelope(native_grid), TRUE) AS clipped
        FROM window_admitted i
    ), window_restored AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT i.grid, i.native_grid,
               ST_AddBand(ST_MakeEmptyRaster(clipped), ARRAY(
                   SELECT ST_SetBandNoDataValue(ST_Band(clipped, n), 1, ST_BandNoDataValue(rast, n))
                   FROM generate_series(1, ST_NumBands(rast)) n ORDER BY n), 1) AS rast
        FROM window_clipped i WHERE clipped IS NOT NULL AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(clipped)
    ), window_masked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT i.native_grid AS grid,
               ST_AddBand(ST_MakeEmptyRaster(i.rast), ARRAY(
                   SELECT ST_SetBandNoDataValue(
                       ST_MapAlgebra(i.rast, n, '64BF', '[rast.val]',
                           CASE WHEN ST_BandPixelType(i.rast, n) = '64BF'
                                     AND ST_ValueCount(i.rast, n, TRUE, -1.7976931348623157e308) > 0
                                THEN ('raster_mosaic_64bf_nodata_collision:' || n)::double precision
                                ELSE -1.7976931348623157e308 END),
                       1, -1.7976931348623157e308)
                   FROM generate_series(1, ST_NumBands(i.rast)) n ORDER BY n), 1) AS rast
        FROM window_restored i
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM generate_series(1, ST_NumBands(i.rast)) n
    WHERE ST_BandPixelType(i.rast, n) = '64BF'
      AND ST_ValueCount(i.rast, n, TRUE, -1.7976931348623157e308) > 0)
    ), window_padded AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT (
    WITH frame_input AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT w.rast AS rast, w.grid AS grid
    ),
    frame_canvas AS (
        SELECT ST_AddBand(i.grid, ARRAY(
                   SELECT ROW(NULL, m.pixeltype, COALESCE(m.nodatavalue, 0), COALESCE(m.nodatavalue, 0))::addbandarg
                   FROM generate_series(1, ST_NumBands(i.rast)) AS n,
                        LATERAL ST_BandMetaData(i.rast, n) AS m
                   ORDER BY n)) AS rast
        FROM frame_input i
        WHERE i.rast IS NOT NULL
    ),
    frame_union AS (
        SELECT ST_Union(layers.rast, 'LAST' ORDER BY layers.layer_order) AS rast
        FROM (
            SELECT rast, 1 AS layer_order FROM frame_canvas
            UNION ALL
            SELECT rast, 2 AS layer_order FROM frame_input WHERE rast IS NOT NULL
        ) layers
    ),
    frame_clipped AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT ST_Clip(u.rast, ST_Envelope(i.grid), TRUE) AS rast
        FROM frame_union u, frame_input i
        WHERE i.rast IS NOT NULL
    )
    SELECT ST_AddBand(i.grid, ARRAY(
        SELECT ST_SetBandNoDataValue(ST_Band(c.rast, n), 1, ST_BandNoDataValue(i.rast, n))
        FROM generate_series(1, ST_NumBands(i.rast)) AS n
        ORDER BY n), 1)
    FROM frame_clipped c, frame_input i
    WHERE i.rast IS NOT NULL
) AS rast FROM window_masked w
    ), window_warped AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT ST_Transform(w.rast, g.grid, 'NearestNeighbor', 0.0) AS rast
        FROM window_padded w, window_input g
    ), window_covered AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT w.rast, g.grid FROM window_warped w, window_input g
        WHERE ST_Covers(ST_Envelope(w.rast), ST_Envelope(g.grid))
    ), window_framed AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT (
    WITH frame_input AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT w.rast AS rast, w.grid AS grid
    ),
    frame_canvas AS (
        SELECT ST_AddBand(i.grid, ARRAY(
                   SELECT ROW(NULL, m.pixeltype, COALESCE(m.nodatavalue, 0), COALESCE(m.nodatavalue, 0))::addbandarg
                   FROM generate_series(1, ST_NumBands(i.rast)) AS n,
                        LATERAL ST_BandMetaData(i.rast, n) AS m
                   ORDER BY n)) AS rast
        FROM frame_input i
        WHERE i.rast IS NOT NULL
    ),
    frame_union AS (
        SELECT ST_Union(layers.rast, 'LAST' ORDER BY layers.layer_order) AS rast
        FROM (
            SELECT rast, 1 AS layer_order FROM frame_canvas
            UNION ALL
            SELECT rast, 2 AS layer_order FROM frame_input WHERE rast IS NOT NULL
        ) layers
    ),
    frame_clipped AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT ST_Clip(u.rast, ST_Envelope(i.grid), TRUE) AS rast
        FROM frame_union u, frame_input i
        WHERE i.rast IS NOT NULL
    )
    SELECT ST_AddBand(i.grid, ARRAY(
        SELECT ST_SetBandNoDataValue(ST_Band(c.rast, n), 1, ST_BandNoDataValue(i.rast, n))
        FROM generate_series(1, ST_NumBands(i.rast)) AS n
        ORDER BY n), 1)
    FROM frame_clipped c, frame_input i
    WHERE i.rast IS NOT NULL
) AS rast
        FROM window_covered w
    )
    SELECT ST_AddBand(ST_MakeEmptyRaster(f.rast), ARRAY(
    SELECT ST_SetBandNoDataValue(
        ST_MapAlgebra(f.rast, n, ST_BandPixelType(i.rast, n), '[rast.val]',
                      COALESCE(ST_BandNoDataValue(i.rast, n), 0)),
        1, ST_BandNoDataValue(i.rast, n))
    FROM generate_series(1, ST_NumBands(i.rast)) n ORDER BY n), 1) FROM window_framed f, window_input i
);
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION honua_raster.native_window_coverage_v1(p_raster raster, p_grid raster)
RETURNS raster
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY INVOKER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
AS $$
SELECT (
    WITH window_input AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT p_raster AS rast, p_grid AS grid
    ), window_eligible AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT i.*, ST_MakeEmptyRaster(i.rast) AS header
        FROM window_input i
        WHERE i.rast IS NOT NULL AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(i.rast)
          AND ST_SkewX(i.rast) = 0 AND ST_SkewY(i.rast) = 0
          AND ST_SkewX(i.grid) = 0 AND ST_SkewY(i.grid) = 0
          AND ST_ScaleX(i.rast) > 0 AND ST_ScaleY(i.rast) < 0
          AND ST_ScaleX(i.grid) > 0 AND ST_ScaleY(i.grid) < 0
          AND abs(ST_ScaleX(i.rast)) BETWEEN 1e-100 AND 1e100
          AND abs(ST_ScaleY(i.rast)) BETWEEN 1e-100 AND 1e100
          AND abs(ST_UpperLeftX(i.rast)) < 1e100
          AND abs(ST_UpperLeftY(i.rast)) < 1e100
          AND abs(ST_ScaleX(i.grid)) BETWEEN 1e-100 AND 1e100
          AND abs(ST_ScaleY(i.grid)) BETWEEN 1e-100 AND 1e100
          AND abs(ST_UpperLeftX(i.grid)) < 1e100
          AND abs(ST_UpperLeftY(i.grid)) < 1e100
          AND ST_NumBands(i.rast) > 0
          AND ((ST_SRID(i.rast) = ST_SRID(i.grid) AND ST_SRID(i.rast) > 0)
               OR (ST_SRID(i.rast) = 4326 AND ST_SRID(i.grid) = 3857
                   AND ST_XMin(ST_Envelope(i.grid)) >= -20037508.342789244
                   AND ST_XMax(ST_Envelope(i.grid)) <= 20037508.342789244
                   AND ST_YMin(ST_Envelope(i.grid)) >= -20037508.342789244
                   AND ST_YMax(ST_Envelope(i.grid)) <= 20037508.342789244))
    ), window_inverse AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT i.*, CASE WHEN ST_SRID(i.rast) = ST_SRID(i.grid)
                         THEN ST_Envelope(i.grid)
                         ELSE ST_Transform(ST_Envelope(i.grid), 4326) END AS bounds
        FROM window_eligible i
    ), window_coordinate_guard AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT i.* FROM window_inverse i
        WHERE (ST_XMin(bounds)::numeric - ST_UpperLeftX(header)::numeric)
                    / NULLIF(ST_ScaleX(header)::numeric, 0) BETWEEN -2147483644 AND 2147483644
          AND (ST_XMax(bounds)::numeric - ST_UpperLeftX(header)::numeric)
                    / NULLIF(ST_ScaleX(header)::numeric, 0) BETWEEN -2147483644 AND 2147483644
          AND (ST_YMin(bounds)::numeric - ST_UpperLeftY(header)::numeric)
                    / NULLIF(ST_ScaleY(header)::numeric, 0) BETWEEN -2147483644 AND 2147483644
          AND (ST_YMax(bounds)::numeric - ST_UpperLeftY(header)::numeric)
                    / NULLIF(ST_ScaleY(header)::numeric, 0) BETWEEN -2147483644 AND 2147483644
    ), window_cells AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT i.*, least(c1.columnx, c2.columnx) - 1 AS c0,
               greatest(c1.columnx, c2.columnx) + 1 AS c1,
               least(c1.rowy, c2.rowy) - 1 AS r0,
               greatest(c1.rowy, c2.rowy) + 1 AS r1
        FROM window_coordinate_guard i
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_WorldToRasterCoord(header, ST_XMin(bounds), ST_YMax(bounds)) c1
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_WorldToRasterCoord(header, ST_XMax(bounds), ST_YMin(bounds)) c2
    ), window_grid AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT i.*, ST_MakeEmptyRaster((c1::bigint - c0 + 1)::integer, (r1::bigint - r0 + 1)::integer, p.longitude, p.latitude,
                   ST_ScaleX(header), ST_ScaleY(header), 0, 0, ST_SRID(header)) AS native_grid
        FROM window_cells i
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_RasterToWorldCoord(header, c0, r0) p
        WHERE c1::bigint - c0 + 1 BETWEEN 1 AND 65535
          AND r1::bigint - r0 + 1 BETWEEN 1 AND 65535
          AND (c1::numeric - c0 + 1) * (r1::numeric - r0 + 1) * ST_NumBands(rast) <= 1048576
    ), window_domain AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT i.* FROM window_grid i
        WHERE ST_SRID(rast) = ST_SRID(grid)
           OR (ST_XMin(ST_Envelope(native_grid)) >= -180
               AND ST_XMax(ST_Envelope(native_grid)) <= 180
               AND ST_YMin(ST_Envelope(native_grid)) > -85.0511287798066
               AND ST_YMax(ST_Envelope(native_grid)) < 85.0511287798066)
    ), window_projected AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT i.*, CASE WHEN ST_SRID(rast) = ST_SRID(grid) THEN ST_Envelope(native_grid)
                         ELSE ST_Transform(ST_Envelope(native_grid), ST_SRID(grid)) END AS projected
        FROM window_domain i
    ), window_estimates AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT i.*,
               ceil((ST_XMax(projected)::numeric - ST_XMin(projected)::numeric)
                        / NULLIF(ST_ScaleX(grid)::numeric, 0) + 2) AS projected_width,
               ceil((ST_YMax(projected)::numeric - ST_YMin(projected)::numeric)
                        / NULLIF(abs(ST_ScaleY(grid))::numeric, 0) + 2) AS projected_height
        FROM window_projected i
    ), window_admitted AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT i.* FROM window_estimates i
        WHERE projected_width BETWEEN 1 AND 65535
          AND projected_height BETWEEN 1 AND 65535
          AND projected_width * projected_height * ST_NumBands(rast) <= 16777216
    ), window_clipped AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT i.*, ST_Clip(rast, ST_Envelope(native_grid), TRUE) AS clipped
        FROM window_admitted i
    ), window_restored AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT i.grid, i.native_grid,
               ST_AddBand(ST_MakeEmptyRaster(clipped), ARRAY(
                   SELECT ST_SetBandNoDataValue(ST_Band(clipped, n), 1, ST_BandNoDataValue(rast, n))
                   FROM generate_series(1, ST_NumBands(rast)) n ORDER BY n), 1) AS rast
        FROM window_clipped i WHERE clipped IS NOT NULL AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(clipped)
    ), window_masked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT i.native_grid AS grid,
               ST_AddBand(ST_MakeEmptyRaster(i.rast), ARRAY(
                   SELECT ST_SetBandNoDataValue(
                       ST_MapAlgebra(i.rast, n, '64BF', '[rast.val]',
                           CASE WHEN ST_BandPixelType(i.rast, n) = '64BF'
                                     AND ST_ValueCount(i.rast, n, TRUE, -1.7976931348623157e308) > 0
                                THEN ('raster_mosaic_64bf_nodata_collision:' || n)::double precision
                                ELSE -1.7976931348623157e308 END),
                       1, -1.7976931348623157e308)
                   FROM generate_series(1, ST_NumBands(i.rast)) n ORDER BY n), 1) AS rast
        FROM window_restored i
        
    ), window_padded AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT (
    WITH frame_input AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT w.rast AS rast, w.grid AS grid
    ),
    frame_canvas AS (
        SELECT ST_AddBand(i.grid, ARRAY(
                   SELECT ROW(NULL, m.pixeltype, COALESCE(m.nodatavalue, 0), COALESCE(m.nodatavalue, 0))::addbandarg
                   FROM generate_series(1, ST_NumBands(i.rast)) AS n,
                        LATERAL ST_BandMetaData(i.rast, n) AS m
                   ORDER BY n)) AS rast
        FROM frame_input i
        WHERE i.rast IS NOT NULL
    ),
    frame_union AS (
        SELECT ST_Union(layers.rast, 'LAST' ORDER BY layers.layer_order) AS rast
        FROM (
            SELECT rast, 1 AS layer_order FROM frame_canvas
            UNION ALL
            SELECT rast, 2 AS layer_order FROM frame_input WHERE rast IS NOT NULL
        ) layers
    ),
    frame_clipped AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT ST_Clip(u.rast, ST_Envelope(i.grid), TRUE) AS rast
        FROM frame_union u, frame_input i
        WHERE i.rast IS NOT NULL
    )
    SELECT ST_AddBand(i.grid, ARRAY(
        SELECT ST_SetBandNoDataValue(ST_Band(c.rast, n), 1, ST_BandNoDataValue(i.rast, n))
        FROM generate_series(1, ST_NumBands(i.rast)) AS n
        ORDER BY n), 1)
    FROM frame_clipped c, frame_input i
    WHERE i.rast IS NOT NULL
) AS rast FROM window_masked w
    ), window_warped AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT ST_Transform(w.rast, g.grid, 'NearestNeighbor', 0.0) AS rast
        FROM window_padded w, window_input g
    ), window_covered AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT w.rast, g.grid FROM window_warped w, window_input g
        WHERE ST_Covers(ST_Envelope(w.rast), ST_Envelope(g.grid))
    ), window_framed AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT (
    WITH frame_input AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT w.rast AS rast, w.grid AS grid
    ),
    frame_canvas AS (
        SELECT ST_AddBand(i.grid, ARRAY(
                   SELECT ROW(NULL, m.pixeltype, COALESCE(m.nodatavalue, 0), COALESCE(m.nodatavalue, 0))::addbandarg
                   FROM generate_series(1, ST_NumBands(i.rast)) AS n,
                        LATERAL ST_BandMetaData(i.rast, n) AS m
                   ORDER BY n)) AS rast
        FROM frame_input i
        WHERE i.rast IS NOT NULL
    ),
    frame_union AS (
        SELECT ST_Union(layers.rast, 'LAST' ORDER BY layers.layer_order) AS rast
        FROM (
            SELECT rast, 1 AS layer_order FROM frame_canvas
            UNION ALL
            SELECT rast, 2 AS layer_order FROM frame_input WHERE rast IS NOT NULL
        ) layers
    ),
    frame_clipped AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT ST_Clip(u.rast, ST_Envelope(i.grid), TRUE) AS rast
        FROM frame_union u, frame_input i
        WHERE i.rast IS NOT NULL
    )
    SELECT ST_AddBand(i.grid, ARRAY(
        SELECT ST_SetBandNoDataValue(ST_Band(c.rast, n), 1, ST_BandNoDataValue(i.rast, n))
        FROM generate_series(1, ST_NumBands(i.rast)) AS n
        ORDER BY n), 1)
    FROM frame_clipped c, frame_input i
    WHERE i.rast IS NOT NULL
) AS rast
        FROM window_covered w
    )
    SELECT f.rast FROM window_framed f, window_input i
);
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION honua_raster.separable_nearest_v1(p_raster raster, p_grid raster)
RETURNS raster
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY INVOKER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
AS $$
SELECT (
    WITH sample_input AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT p_raster AS rast, p_grid AS grid
    ), sample_eligible AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT i.*, ST_MakeEmptyRaster(i.rast) AS header,
               ST_Width(i.rast) AS sw, ST_Height(i.rast) AS sh,
               ST_Width(i.grid) AS w, ST_Height(i.grid) AS h,
               ST_UpperLeftX(i.rast) AS sulx, ST_UpperLeftY(i.rast) AS suly,
               ST_UpperLeftX(i.grid) AS gulx, ST_UpperLeftY(i.grid) AS guly,
               ST_ScaleX(i.grid) AS gsx, ST_ScaleY(i.grid) AS gsy
        FROM sample_input i
        WHERE i.rast IS NOT NULL AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(i.rast)
          AND ST_Width(i.grid) BETWEEN 1 AND 256 AND ST_Height(i.grid) BETWEEN 1 AND 256
          AND ST_NumBands(i.rast) BETWEEN 1 AND 16
          AND ST_SkewX(i.rast) = 0 AND ST_SkewY(i.rast) = 0
          AND ST_SkewX(i.grid) = 0 AND ST_SkewY(i.grid) = 0
          AND ST_ScaleX(i.rast) BETWEEN 1e-100 AND 1e100
          AND -ST_ScaleY(i.rast) BETWEEN 1e-100 AND 1e100
          AND ST_ScaleX(i.grid) BETWEEN 1e-100 AND 1e100
          AND -ST_ScaleY(i.grid) BETWEEN 1e-100 AND 1e100
          AND abs(ST_UpperLeftX(i.rast)) < 1e100 AND abs(ST_UpperLeftY(i.rast)) < 1e100
          AND abs(ST_UpperLeftX(i.grid)) < 1e100 AND abs(ST_UpperLeftY(i.grid)) < 1e100
          AND ((ST_SRID(i.rast) = ST_SRID(i.grid) AND ST_SRID(i.rast) > 0)
               OR (ST_SRID(i.rast) = 4326 AND ST_SRID(i.grid) = 3857
                   AND ST_XMin(ST_Envelope(i.grid)) >= -20037508.342789244
                   AND ST_XMax(ST_Envelope(i.grid)) <= 20037508.342789244
                   AND ST_YMin(ST_Envelope(i.grid)) >= -20037508.342789244
                   AND ST_YMax(ST_Envelope(i.grid)) <= 20037508.342789244))
    ), sample_axis AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT i.*, CASE WHEN ST_SRID(rast) = ST_SRID(grid) THEN ST_Envelope(grid)
                         ELSE ST_Transform(ST_Envelope(grid), 4326) END AS inverse_bounds
        FROM sample_eligible i
    ), sample_guard AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT i.* FROM sample_axis i
        WHERE (ST_XMin(inverse_bounds)::numeric - sulx::numeric)
                      / NULLIF(ST_ScaleX(header)::numeric, 0) BETWEEN -2147483644 AND 2147483644
          AND (ST_XMax(inverse_bounds)::numeric - sulx::numeric)
                      / NULLIF(ST_ScaleX(header)::numeric, 0) BETWEEN -2147483644 AND 2147483644
          AND (ST_YMin(inverse_bounds)::numeric - suly::numeric)
                      / NULLIF(ST_ScaleY(header)::numeric, 0) BETWEEN -2147483644 AND 2147483644
          AND (ST_YMax(inverse_bounds)::numeric - suly::numeric)
                      / NULLIF(ST_ScaleY(header)::numeric, 0) BETWEEN -2147483644 AND 2147483644
    ), sample_columns AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT x, c.columnx FROM sample_guard i CROSS JOIN generate_series(1, 256) x
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT CASE WHEN ST_SRID(header) = ST_SRID(grid)
                        THEN gulx + (x - 0.5) * gsx
                        ELSE ST_X(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(gulx + (x - 0.5) * gsx, 0), 3857), 4326)) END AS longitude
        ) p
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_WorldToRasterCoord(header, p.longitude, suly) c
        WHERE x <= w
    ), sample_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT y, c.rowy FROM sample_guard i CROSS JOIN generate_series(1, 256) y
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT CASE WHEN ST_SRID(header) = ST_SRID(grid)
                        THEN guly + (y - 0.5) * gsy
                        ELSE ST_Y(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(0, guly + (y - 0.5) * gsy), 3857), 4326)) END AS latitude
        ) p
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_WorldToRasterCoord(header, sulx, p.latitude) c
        WHERE y <= h
    ), sample_coordinates AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT x, y, columnx, rowy FROM sample_columns CROSS JOIN sample_rows
    ), sample_metadata AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT n, ST_BandPixelType(rast, n) AS pixeltype,
               ST_BandNoDataValue(rast, n) AS nodatavalue
        FROM sample_guard, generate_series(1, 16) n WHERE n <= ST_NumBands(rast)
    ), sample_requested AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT DISTINCT columnx, rowy FROM sample_coordinates, sample_guard
        WHERE columnx BETWEEN 1 AND sw AND rowy BETWEEN 1 AND sh
    ), sample_value_bounds AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT min(columnx) AS c0, max(columnx) AS c1,
               min(rowy) AS r0, max(rowy) AS r1, count(*) AS requested
        FROM sample_requested
    ), sample_value_grid AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT b.*, ST_MakeEmptyRaster(c1 - c0 + 1, r1 - r0 + 1,
            i.sulx + (c0 - 1) * ST_ScaleX(i.header),
            i.suly + (r0 - 1) * ST_ScaleY(i.header),
            ST_ScaleX(i.header), ST_ScaleY(i.header), 0, 0, ST_SRID(i.header)) AS grid
        FROM sample_value_bounds b, sample_guard i
        WHERE requested > 256
          AND (c1::numeric - c0 + 1) * (r1::numeric - r0 + 1) * ST_NumBands(i.rast) <= 16777216
    ), sample_value_clip AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT g.*, ST_Clip(i.rast, ST_Envelope(g.grid), TRUE) AS rast
        FROM sample_value_grid g, sample_guard i
    ), sample_value_arrays AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT m.n, v.c0, v.r0, ST_DumpValues(v.rast, m.n, FALSE) AS vals
        FROM sample_value_clip v, sample_metadata m
        WHERE ST_Width(v.rast) = v.c1 - v.c0 + 1
          AND ST_Height(v.rast) = v.r1 - v.r0 + 1
          AND ST_SameAlignment(v.rast, v.grid)
          AND ST_Equals(ST_ConvexHull(v.rast), ST_ConvexHull(v.grid))
    ), sample_values AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT v.columnx, v.rowy, m.n, v.value
        FROM sample_metadata m CROSS JOIN sample_guard i
        LEFT JOIN sample_value_arrays a ON a.n = m.n
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT r.columnx, r.rowy,
                   CASE WHEN a.n IS NOT NULL THEN a.vals[r.rowy - a.r0 + 1][r.columnx - a.c0 + 1]
                        ELSE ST_Value(i.rast, m.n, r.columnx, r.rowy, FALSE) END AS value
            FROM sample_requested r
            OFFSET 0
        ) v
    ), sample_row_arrays AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT m.n, y, array_agg(CASE WHEN v.columnx IS NOT NULL THEN v.value
                                   ELSE COALESCE(m.nodatavalue, 0) END ORDER BY x) AS vals
        FROM sample_coordinates c CROSS JOIN sample_metadata m
        LEFT JOIN sample_values v ON v.columnx = c.columnx AND v.rowy = c.rowy AND v.n = m.n
        GROUP BY m.n, y
    ), sample_arrays AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT n, array_agg(vals ORDER BY y) AS vals FROM sample_row_arrays GROUP BY n
    ), sample_bands AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT a.n, ST_SetValues(ST_AddBand(i.grid, m.pixeltype, COALESCE(m.nodatavalue, 0), m.nodatavalue),
                                 1, 1, 1, a.vals) AS rast
        FROM sample_arrays a JOIN sample_metadata m USING (n), sample_guard i
    )
    SELECT ST_AddBand(i.grid, ARRAY(SELECT b.rast FROM sample_bands b ORDER BY n), 1)
    FROM sample_guard i
);
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION honua_raster.separable_nearest_coverage_v1(p_raster raster, p_grid raster)
RETURNS raster
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY INVOKER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
AS $$
SELECT (
    WITH sample_input AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT p_raster AS rast, p_grid AS grid
    ), sample_eligible AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT i.*, ST_MakeEmptyRaster(i.rast) AS header,
               ST_Width(i.rast) AS sw, ST_Height(i.rast) AS sh,
               ST_Width(i.grid) AS w, ST_Height(i.grid) AS h,
               ST_UpperLeftX(i.rast) AS sulx, ST_UpperLeftY(i.rast) AS suly,
               ST_UpperLeftX(i.grid) AS gulx, ST_UpperLeftY(i.grid) AS guly,
               ST_ScaleX(i.grid) AS gsx, ST_ScaleY(i.grid) AS gsy
        FROM sample_input i
        WHERE i.rast IS NOT NULL AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(i.rast)
          AND ST_Width(i.grid) BETWEEN 1 AND 256 AND ST_Height(i.grid) BETWEEN 1 AND 256
          AND ST_NumBands(i.rast) BETWEEN 1 AND 16
          AND ST_SkewX(i.rast) = 0 AND ST_SkewY(i.rast) = 0
          AND ST_SkewX(i.grid) = 0 AND ST_SkewY(i.grid) = 0
          AND ST_ScaleX(i.rast) BETWEEN 1e-100 AND 1e100
          AND -ST_ScaleY(i.rast) BETWEEN 1e-100 AND 1e100
          AND ST_ScaleX(i.grid) BETWEEN 1e-100 AND 1e100
          AND -ST_ScaleY(i.grid) BETWEEN 1e-100 AND 1e100
          AND abs(ST_UpperLeftX(i.rast)) < 1e100 AND abs(ST_UpperLeftY(i.rast)) < 1e100
          AND abs(ST_UpperLeftX(i.grid)) < 1e100 AND abs(ST_UpperLeftY(i.grid)) < 1e100
          AND ((ST_SRID(i.rast) = ST_SRID(i.grid) AND ST_SRID(i.rast) > 0)
               OR (ST_SRID(i.rast) = 4326 AND ST_SRID(i.grid) = 3857
                   AND ST_XMin(ST_Envelope(i.grid)) >= -20037508.342789244
                   AND ST_XMax(ST_Envelope(i.grid)) <= 20037508.342789244
                   AND ST_YMin(ST_Envelope(i.grid)) >= -20037508.342789244
                   AND ST_YMax(ST_Envelope(i.grid)) <= 20037508.342789244))
    ), sample_axis AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT i.*, CASE WHEN ST_SRID(rast) = ST_SRID(grid) THEN ST_Envelope(grid)
                         ELSE ST_Transform(ST_Envelope(grid), 4326) END AS inverse_bounds
        FROM sample_eligible i
    ), sample_guard AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT i.* FROM sample_axis i
        WHERE (ST_XMin(inverse_bounds)::numeric - sulx::numeric)
                      / NULLIF(ST_ScaleX(header)::numeric, 0) BETWEEN -2147483644 AND 2147483644
          AND (ST_XMax(inverse_bounds)::numeric - sulx::numeric)
                      / NULLIF(ST_ScaleX(header)::numeric, 0) BETWEEN -2147483644 AND 2147483644
          AND (ST_YMin(inverse_bounds)::numeric - suly::numeric)
                      / NULLIF(ST_ScaleY(header)::numeric, 0) BETWEEN -2147483644 AND 2147483644
          AND (ST_YMax(inverse_bounds)::numeric - suly::numeric)
                      / NULLIF(ST_ScaleY(header)::numeric, 0) BETWEEN -2147483644 AND 2147483644
    ), sample_columns AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT x, c.columnx FROM sample_guard i CROSS JOIN generate_series(1, 256) x
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT CASE WHEN ST_SRID(header) = ST_SRID(grid)
                        THEN gulx + (x - 0.5) * gsx
                        ELSE ST_X(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(gulx + (x - 0.5) * gsx, 0), 3857), 4326)) END AS longitude
        ) p
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_WorldToRasterCoord(header, p.longitude, suly) c
        WHERE x <= w
    ), sample_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT y, c.rowy FROM sample_guard i CROSS JOIN generate_series(1, 256) y
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT CASE WHEN ST_SRID(header) = ST_SRID(grid)
                        THEN guly + (y - 0.5) * gsy
                        ELSE ST_Y(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(0, guly + (y - 0.5) * gsy), 3857), 4326)) END AS latitude
        ) p
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_WorldToRasterCoord(header, sulx, p.latitude) c
        WHERE y <= h
    ), sample_coordinates AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT x, y, columnx, rowy FROM sample_columns CROSS JOIN sample_rows
    ), sample_metadata AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT n, ST_BandPixelType(rast, n) AS pixeltype,
               ST_BandNoDataValue(rast, n) AS nodatavalue
        FROM sample_guard, generate_series(1, 16) n WHERE n <= ST_NumBands(rast)
    ), sample_requested AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT DISTINCT columnx, rowy FROM sample_coordinates, sample_guard
        WHERE columnx BETWEEN 1 AND sw AND rowy BETWEEN 1 AND sh
    ), sample_value_bounds AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT min(columnx) AS c0, max(columnx) AS c1,
               min(rowy) AS r0, max(rowy) AS r1, count(*) AS requested
        FROM sample_requested
    ), sample_value_grid AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT b.*, ST_MakeEmptyRaster(c1 - c0 + 1, r1 - r0 + 1,
            i.sulx + (c0 - 1) * ST_ScaleX(i.header),
            i.suly + (r0 - 1) * ST_ScaleY(i.header),
            ST_ScaleX(i.header), ST_ScaleY(i.header), 0, 0, ST_SRID(i.header)) AS grid
        FROM sample_value_bounds b, sample_guard i
        WHERE requested > 256
          AND (c1::numeric - c0 + 1) * (r1::numeric - r0 + 1) * ST_NumBands(i.rast) <= 16777216
    ), sample_value_clip AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT g.*, ST_Clip(i.rast, ST_Envelope(g.grid), TRUE) AS rast
        FROM sample_value_grid g, sample_guard i
    ), sample_value_arrays AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT m.n, v.c0, v.r0, ST_DumpValues(v.rast, m.n, FALSE) AS vals
        FROM sample_value_clip v, sample_metadata m
        WHERE ST_Width(v.rast) = v.c1 - v.c0 + 1
          AND ST_Height(v.rast) = v.r1 - v.r0 + 1
          AND ST_SameAlignment(v.rast, v.grid)
          AND ST_Equals(ST_ConvexHull(v.rast), ST_ConvexHull(v.grid))
    ), sample_values AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT v.columnx, v.rowy, m.n, v.value
        FROM sample_metadata m CROSS JOIN sample_guard i
        LEFT JOIN sample_value_arrays a ON a.n = m.n
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT r.columnx, r.rowy,
                   CASE WHEN a.n IS NOT NULL THEN a.vals[r.rowy - a.r0 + 1][r.columnx - a.c0 + 1]
                        ELSE ST_Value(i.rast, m.n, r.columnx, r.rowy, FALSE) END AS value
            FROM sample_requested r
            OFFSET 0
        ) v
    ), sample_row_arrays AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT m.n, y, array_agg(CASE WHEN v.columnx IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN v.value IS NOT DISTINCT FROM m.nodatavalue THEN -1.7976931348623157e308
     WHEN v.value = -1.7976931348623157e308
     THEN ('raster_mosaic_64bf_nodata_collision:' || m.n)::double precision
     ELSE v.value END
                                   ELSE -1.7976931348623157e308 END ORDER BY x) AS vals
        FROM sample_coordinates c CROSS JOIN sample_metadata m
        LEFT JOIN sample_values v ON v.columnx = c.columnx AND v.rowy = c.rowy AND v.n = m.n
        GROUP BY m.n, y
    ), sample_arrays AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT n, array_agg(vals ORDER BY y) AS vals FROM sample_row_arrays GROUP BY n
    ), sample_bands AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT a.n, ST_SetValues(ST_AddBand(i.grid, '64BF', -1.7976931348623157e308, -1.7976931348623157e308),
                                 1, 1, 1, a.vals) AS rast
        FROM sample_arrays a JOIN sample_metadata m USING (n), sample_guard i
    )
    SELECT ST_AddBand(i.grid, ARRAY(SELECT b.rast FROM sample_bands b ORDER BY n), 1)
    FROM sample_guard i
);
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION honua_raster.general_nearest_v1(p_raster raster, p_grid raster)
RETURNS raster
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY INVOKER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
AS $$
SELECT (
    WITH nearest_input AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT s.*, ST_MakeEmptyRaster(s.rast) AS header,
               ST_Width(s.rast) AS sw, ST_Height(s.rast) AS sh,
               ST_Width(s.grid) AS w, ST_Height(s.grid) AS h,
               ST_UpperLeftX(s.grid) AS ulx, ST_UpperLeftY(s.grid) AS uly,
               ST_ScaleX(s.grid) AS sx, ST_ScaleY(s.grid) AS sy,
               ST_SkewX(s.grid) AS kx, ST_SkewY(s.grid) AS ky,
               ST_UpperLeftX(s.rast)::numeric AS sulx, ST_UpperLeftY(s.rast)::numeric AS suly,
               ST_ScaleX(s.rast)::numeric AS ssx, ST_ScaleY(s.rast)::numeric AS ssy,
               ST_SkewX(s.rast)::numeric AS skx, ST_SkewY(s.rast)::numeric AS sky,
               ST_SRID(s.grid) AS grid_srid
        FROM (SELECT p_raster AS rast, p_grid AS grid) s
    ),
    nearest_centers AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT ST_Collect(ARRAY(
            SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(
                i.ulx + (x - 0.5) * i.sx + (y - 0.5) * i.kx,
                i.uly + (x - 0.5) * i.ky + (y - 0.5) * i.sy),
                i.grid_srid)
            FROM generate_series(1, i.h) y,
                 generate_series(1, i.w) x
            ORDER BY y, x)) AS points
        FROM nearest_input i WHERE i.rast IS NOT NULL
    ),
    nearest_projected AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT CASE WHEN ST_SRID(i.rast) = i.grid_srid THEN c.points
            ELSE ST_Transform(c.points, ST_SRID(i.rast)) END AS points
        FROM nearest_input i, nearest_centers c
    ),
    nearest_affine AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT (p.path[1] - 1) % i.w + 1 AS x,
               (p.path[1] - 1) / i.w + 1 AS y,
               ST_X(p.geom) AS wx, ST_Y(p.geom) AS wy,
               ((ST_X(p.geom)::numeric - i.sulx) * i.ssy
                - (ST_Y(p.geom)::numeric - i.suly) * i.skx)
                    / NULLIF(i.ssx * i.ssy - i.skx * i.sky, 0) AS cx,
               ((ST_Y(p.geom)::numeric - i.suly) * i.ssx
                - (ST_X(p.geom)::numeric - i.sulx) * i.sky)
                    / NULLIF(i.ssx * i.ssy - i.skx * i.sky, 0) AS cy
        FROM nearest_input i, nearest_projected t,
             LATERAL ST_DumpPoints(t.points) p
    ),
    nearest_coordinates AS MATERIALIZED (
        -- Numeric affine bounds are only an overflow guard. PostGIS retains
        -- canonical cell-boundary rounding for every representable point.
        -- CASE protects the native calls independently of planner WHERE ordering.
        SELECT p.x, p.y,
               CASE WHEN p.cx BETWEEN -2147483644 AND 2147483644
                         AND p.cy BETWEEN -2147483644 AND 2147483644
                    THEN ST_WorldToRasterCoordX(i.header, p.wx, p.wy) END AS columnx,
               CASE WHEN p.cx BETWEEN -2147483644 AND 2147483644
                         AND p.cy BETWEEN -2147483644 AND 2147483644
                    THEN ST_WorldToRasterCoordY(i.header, p.wx, p.wy) END AS rowy
        FROM nearest_input i, nearest_affine p
    ),
    nearest_metadata AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT n, ST_BandPixelType(i.rast, n) AS pixeltype,
               ST_BandNoDataValue(i.rast, n) AS nodatavalue
        FROM nearest_input i, generate_series(1, ST_NumBands(i.rast)) n
    ),
    nearest_requested AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT DISTINCT c.columnx, c.rowy
        FROM nearest_coordinates c, nearest_input i
        WHERE c.columnx BETWEEN 1 AND i.sw
          AND c.rowy BETWEEN 1 AND i.sh
    ),
    nearest_values AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT c.columnx, c.rowy, m.n,
               ST_Value(i.rast, m.n, c.columnx, c.rowy, FALSE) AS value
        FROM nearest_requested c, nearest_input i, nearest_metadata m
    ),
    nearest_rows AS (
        SELECT m.n, c.y, array_agg(CASE WHEN v.columnx IS NOT NULL THEN v.value
            ELSE COALESCE(m.nodatavalue, 0) END ORDER BY c.x) AS cell_values
        FROM nearest_coordinates c CROSS JOIN nearest_metadata m
        LEFT JOIN nearest_values v ON v.columnx = c.columnx AND v.rowy = c.rowy AND v.n = m.n
        GROUP BY m.n, c.y
    ),
    nearest_arrays AS (
        SELECT n, array_agg(cell_values ORDER BY y) AS cell_values
        FROM nearest_rows GROUP BY n
    ),
    nearest_bands AS (
        SELECT a.n, ST_SetValues(
            ST_AddBand(i.grid, m.pixeltype, COALESCE(m.nodatavalue, 0), m.nodatavalue),
            1, 1, 1, a.cell_values) AS rast
        FROM nearest_arrays a JOIN nearest_metadata m USING (n), nearest_input i
    )
    SELECT ST_AddBand(i.grid, ARRAY(SELECT b.rast FROM nearest_bands b ORDER BY b.n), 1)
    FROM nearest_input i WHERE i.rast IS NOT NULL
);
$$
